anchorSemantics: CSS background-position-y percentage: the image point at p% is aligned with the band point at p%. That is why it survives a changing hero height — it is a ratio, not a pixel offset. p=50 centres the image; the LIVE default is 78 (Al Crop C, 2026-08-06), NOT 50 — changing that default would re-frame all 294 images and needs Al eyes of its own.
